subject: [PATCH 9/9] mm/gup: unshare-check every page of a pte batch

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Expressed confusion about the problem being solved and requested a step-by-step explanation of the sequence of events leading to the bug. Did not provide any technical feedback or suggestions.

reviews.author: Rik van Riel
reviews.summary: Provided a detailed explanation of the problem and proposed fix, including a step-by-step sequence of events that leads to the bug. Did not address any specific technical concerns or suggestions raised by David Hildenbrand.

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a bug in the mm/gup code, specifically in the handling of FOLL_FORCE and FOLL_WRITE flags during page table entry (PTE) batch operations. The issue arises when a process writes to a shared anonymous page that has been pinned by another process using GUP-fast. The fix involves adding checks for FOLL_WRITE similar to those already present for FOLL_PIN, ensuring that the pin holder sees the correct page content.
